scenario.brief: Imani is the product manager at Fernhill, a class-booking app for yoga studios. She wrote a short PRD for the accounts backend. Launch is in eight weeks. She wants your plan: what you build, and in what order.
scenario.role: Backend engineer who will build the accounts service.
scenario.goal: Settle what the PRD leaves open, then propose endpoints, a data model, security choices and a build order.
rules: Imani is in the chat. She answers questions about the product, the users and the launch.
She will not hand you the missing details. Ask for them.
Then propose your plan. She will ask what each part means for members and for launch.
When you are ready, press End and debrief.
scenario.artifactNote: 33 lines. Read it for vague lines, missing stories and rules that may clash.

rubric.criterion: First users and how they get in
levels: Never asks who uses it on day one
Learns who they are or spots a rule that does not fit them
Plans how they get accounts and passwords, with link lifetimes that fit

Orders by dependency and deadline, says what waits, and confirms assumptions with Imani

code.caption: The PRD Imani wrote. It is short on purpose.
